Broad rally, and same-day calls got chased

S&P +2.4%, Nasdaq +3.5%, Russell +3.2%: a gap up and a steady climb into the 15:15–15:30 highs. Same-day delta came out positive, which is rare even on up days. Hedges were adjusted, not dropped: S&P puts were rolled lower for a credit, Russell puts stepped up three times.
